coverage_contract.note: Coverage is by section/status family and event trigger; Section 03 now includes ten review leaves through scaffold/rigging geometry, stage zones, and stage layers; no review_due_at, approval date, surveyed value, clearance, permission, structural authority, or operational activation was invented.

data.validation_limitation: When jsonschema is unavailable, structural/local-reference/representative checks may pass but full Draft 2020-12 metaschema and format assertions remain outstanding and are an explicit revalidation trigger.

cadence.maximum_interval: 12 months after controlled approval; no calendar due date exists before approval

triggers: any controlled source hash or authority change
registered conflict, privacy, rights, or approval finding
before extracting a newly dependent section
validation failure or unavailable required evidence
checks: source hashes and local references resolve
schedules.stale_behavior: Mark affected material working, conflict, blocked, or invalid as evidence warrants; block dependent promotion; notify owner and approver roles.

cadence.maximum_interval: 12 months after controlled approval; no calendar due date exists before approval

triggers: consumer shape or identity vocabulary change
before a dependent schema or authority release
checks: all 24 leaves pass structural and local-reference checks
full metaschema and format assertions run when jsonschema is available
no schema freezes draft business facts
schedules.stale_behavior: Block dependent release, preserve the last approved schema if one exists, and open a validation question/finding.

cadence.maximum_interval: 12 months after controlled approval; no calendar due date exists before approval

triggers: project identity, scope, role, safety authority, relationship, event, or venue evidence changes
before publication, booking use, event advance, or role assignment
rights, affiliation, privacy, accessibility, or approval finding
source hash mismatch or validation failure
checks: all authored Section 01 leaves retain verified or explicitly unresolved claim states
event-specific facts are not promoted into GEN identity
role authority remains separate from named people and assignments
organization claims have scope-specific evidence and restricted contacts remain excluded
schedules.stale_behavior: Block affected dependent claims and releases; preserve unresolved states; register the exact evidence need and escalate to the responsible specialist and approver roles.

triggers: controlled DOCX revision or active timing-profile decision
HOLD, ABORT, STOP, incident, near miss, rehearsal, or performance change proposal
public release request or rights/privacy/safety/accessibility gate change
source becomes stale, missing, restricted, or hash-mismatched
role/authority, venue, distribution, or retention requirement changes
checks: affected dependencies and distribution recipients are identified
obsolete operational copies have withdrawal evidence when applicable
schedules.stale_behavior: Fail closed: retain the prior approved revision if available, register the exact blocker/conflict, escalate to the named owner/approver role, and never substitute unavailable evidence.
